description: Creates a saved board from published catalog parts and verified pins: its schematic, its size and the position of every part and designator. Saving also routes and checks the board: this call waits for that and returns the board as it is afterwards. Supply a fresh private boardRef, name, requestId, intent and boardEdits. To make boardRef, generate 32 random bytes locally, encode as unpadded base64url and prepend egbr1_. The server uses the connected account when available; otherwise it establishes private board access automatically. Keep this SAME boardRef for all later reads, edits, status and export calls. Store it in this conversation or supported private execution state before submitting; do not discard it between isolated calls. Identical retries with the same boardRef, requestId and arguments recover the original creation. Do not use a new reference to recover existing work. For a guest board, show the board name and offer saveToAccount as an optional link to find it in My Boards later. Preserve the complete private link for this user; never log private references or put them in source files. Server defaults supply the other settings, footprints, models and manufacturing limits; change them only when the request asks. Account boards are personal unless organizationId is specified. Use the returned revision for later edits. validation lists any blocking issues to fix; if it is null while layout.current is true, call check_board_layout. If the result has pollAfterSeconds, the layout is still running: follow generation with get_generation using the same boardRef, then use its boardRevision and call check_board_layout. If layoutNotStarted is returned instead, the board is saved but its layout did not start; call generate_layout after any stated wait. Use update_board for existing work. Thin intent format: each parts entry is an array of strings [id, dbId, value], with an optional fourth designator. Choose id as the design-local part ID; copy dbId from the catalog result's id; value is the required value/display label. Omit the fourth designator when it matches id. Each connections entry is {net, class, pins}; class is power, signal, or ground. Each pins entry is [partId, padId]: use the design-local part ID and copy padId from the catalog result's pins[].number, both as strings. Optional pinCurrentRequirements uses those same partId and padId identities with requiredCurrentA in amperes and direction into, out, or bidirectional relative to the net. Omit the list to retain existing values; a supplied list replaces it, and [] clears it. Placement: nothing is placed or sized automatically. Board coordinates are mm from the lower-left corner of the board (of its bounding box for a circle or an outline), x right and y up. Set boardEdits.settings.width and height in mm, a circle diameter, or an outline. Put each part and its reference label in the same boardEdits.fixedPlacements.upsert item, for example {"partId":"R1","x":10,"y":8,"designator":"above"}. Choose a free side in board directions ("above" = +y, "below" = -y, "left" = -x, "right" = +x). The label is centered along the chosen side with 0.2 mm to the rotated footprint extent. Leave room for the entire label plus 0.5 mm to neighboring parts. For off-center placement use an end of a side, such as "above-left" or "left-top". A mounting hole needs no reference label. For an exact label position, supply boardEdits.silkscreenTexts.upsert with {id: "refdes_<partId>", x, y} instead of designator on that placement. A test point needs one label, which prints its net: name the side of the point it stands on with label: "above" | "below" | "left" | "right" on the testPoints entry, or position a silkscreenTexts entry {id: "tp_<test point ID>", x, y} yourself. Catalog results that carry pins also carry geometry in mm at rotation 0 on the top side, x right and y up from the footprint origin: body [width, height], extent [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] of everything the footprint occupies, pins {number: [x, y]} and a connector's opening; call get_part when a chosen part has none. For bottom-face placement mirror local x first, then apply the counterclockwise rotation to the geometry. Keep every extent inside the outline with 1 mm to spare and 1 mm from other extents, more where traces must pass; a rectangle has corners rounded to a 2 mm radius unless settings.roundedCorners is false, and an extent in a corner must clear that curve too. An external receptacle sits at a board edge with its opening outward; if geometry.overhang is present, the opening side may protrude by the stated min to max distance in mm. Put connected parts next to each other and support parts at the pins they serve. A designator is positioned by the centre of its text and counts as 0.8 mm per character wide and 1 mm tall: keep it at least 0.2 mm outside every part's extent, 0.3 mm inside the outline and 0.2 mm from other labels, within 3 mm of its own part and at least 0.3 mm nearer to it than to any other part. Each of these distances is measured from the box the text covers to a part's extent, not between centres. Size the board to the arrangement. For a misplaced label choose a side in suggestedSides on the matching fixedPlacements.upsert item, or use suggestedPosition as its exact silkscreenTexts.upsert center. Omit the label's old refdes_<partId> entry from the outgoing silkscreenTexts.upsert when using a side, so explicit coordinates do not override the named side. When no position is suggested, follow the issue message to make room. settings.layers defaults to auto: the layout chooses one or two copper layers and saves its choice as the board's layers, which later layouts keep until an edit sets settings.layers again. A successful save can return placementIssues for physically misplaced reference labels. The board is saved: call update_board with the same boardRef, the returned revision as expectedRevision, a new requestId, and only the boardEdits needed to repair those labels. If the tool returns an error instead, preserve the schematic and valid catalog parts, correct the returned detailed issues, and keep the same boardRef. Use a new requestId when input changes; reuse the same requestId and arguments for an unchanged retry. Research again only when an issue needs missing part or pin information.

labelSide.description: Label position in board directions. Above is +y and right is +x.

segments.description: Connected lines/arcs; close explicitly; no zero lengths or crossings.

center.description: Board-frame center, equidistant from arc endpoints.

clockwise.description: True=clockwise, false=CCW; full circles need ≥2 arcs.

end.description: Arc end; unequal to prior end/start.

boardEdits.description: For a first save, give the board a numeric width and height in mm, a circle diameter or an outline, and locate every part in intent.parts. Nothing is placed or sized automatically: the layout only routes. Later edits retain omitted settings and placements. outline replaces the outline with a library choice, a complete generated profile including retained cutouts, or a DXF file: kind dxf with source holding the file's complete text. The closed outline drawn in the file becomes the board edge and closed shapes inside it become cutouts; state unit when the file declares none and layer when several layers hold outline geometry. An imported outline is converted to mm and moved so the lower-left corner of its bounding box is the board origin. In fixedPlacements.upsert locate each footprint origin with x and y or a relative edge/perimeter position. Choose the reference label position with designator, e.g. {"partId":"R1","x":10,"y":8,"designator":"above"}. A mounting hole needs no label. For an exact label center use silkscreenTexts.upsert with id "refdes_<partId>", x and y instead. The service supplies the label text, board face and 1 mm height. partClearances use design-local partId; keepouts, mountingHoles, silkscreenTexts, and silkscreenSvgs use item id. Keepout shape coordinates are board-plane mm; part clearance distances are in the part-local frame. Each collection uses upsert to add or merge items and remove to remove only listed IDs, not replace the collection. Remove a part's fixed placement only together with the part. Positions are in board-plane mm; rotationDeg is counterclockwise degrees. New SVG artwork cannot be added through MCP. Existing SVG artwork can be edited or removed by item id; omit assetId.

upsert.description: Upsert by partId; retain omitted fields.

items.description: New unplaced parts require x and y or a relative position. Omitted coordinates inherit a saved fixed or realized pose; side/rotation alone require that pose.

alignment.description: X-axis: CCW tangent/inward normal; vertex bisector. Board-frame on both sides; no polarity/direction inference. Omit to retain rotation; excludes rotationDeg.

fraction.description: Outer-contour CCW arclength; 1=0. Start: rectangle (cornerRadius,0), circle bottom, custom profile.outer.start.

rotationOffsetDeg.description: CCW degrees added to required alignment; default 0.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

items.description: Board-fixed exclusion region. New items require name, x, y, rotationDeg, shape, restrictions, partSide and copperLayers. Nested objects replace complete fields; omission retains existing values.

copperLayers.description: Copper layers it applies to: ≥1 when restricting copper, each on the board.

restrictions.description: Complete restriction set; at least one must be true.

shape.description: Complete replacement shape; omitted retains the current shape.

profile.description: Complete custom keepout profile in mm; scaled width and height 0.1–1000, ≤2000 total segments.

cutouts.description: Closed voids ([]=none); prefer clockwise. Strictly inside; no touching, overlap or nesting.

scalePercent.description: Uniform scale of the original profile; omitted is 100.

sourceBase64.description: Existing retained DXF source only; never invent source bytes.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

source.description: Complete text of an ASCII DXF file, at most 2 MB.

profile.description: Complete mm profile, retained cutouts; width 5–400, height 5–500; ≤2000 total segments. Omit width/height/diameter. Normalized origin/winding, 0.000001 mm precision.

cutouts.description: Closed voids ([]=none); prefer clockwise. Strictly inside; no touching, overlap or nesting.

upsert.description: Upsert by partId; retain omitted fields.

items.description: Part-attached clearance without pinning the part. New items require clearanceMm, linked, restrictions and copperLayers. Nested objects replace complete fields; omission retains existing values.

clearanceMm.description: Distances from the catalog body in its local frame; front is +Y before placement rotation or bottom-side reflection.

copperLayers.description: Copper layers it applies to: ≥1 when restricting copper, each on the board.

linked.description: Linked sides must have equal clearance distances.

restrictions.description: Complete restriction set; at least one must be true.

allowedPartSides.description: Global policy; omission preserves supplied settings. Fixed placements must use a permitted side. Include any authorized policy change in the same patch; preserve explicit user side restrictions unless the user changes them.

copperPourClearanceMm.description: Copper pour clearance in mm to foreign copper: 0.10–1.00 for 1oz, 0.20–1.00 for 2oz; default 0.20. Null selects Automatic. Existing values outside this range remain valid when unchanged. Changes require regenerating the board.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

assetId.description: Attached SVG ID; required for new artwork.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

items.description: x, y is the centre of the text.

text.description: One printable Roboto Mono line per label. Give each line its own ID and position.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

items.description: Bare-copper net probe, not a part. New: netName, x, y. Default 1.5 mm top pad; both = 0.9 mm via, if asked.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

intent.description: Complete initial schematic using published catalog IDs and verified pins. Parts and connections use the thin intent format described by this tool.

maxTemperatureRiseC.description: Legacy: unchanged current requirements only; else omit. Regenerated layouts use 10°C above ambient.

items.description: [partId,padId] strings: local part ID, catalog pad number.

requiredCurrentA.description: Legacy net-wide current; preserve existing values only. Author new current requirements with pinCurrentRequirements.

targetImpedanceOhms.description: Single-ended ohms; no default. Honor device requirements. Pair targets go on differentialPairs.
Differential ohms; honor device requirements. Defaults: USB full/high-speed 90, LVDS 100, generic/custom none.

items.description: [id,dbId,value] strings; fourth designator if unlike id.

pinCurrentRequirements.description: Complete per-pin requirement list. Omit to preserve existing valid requirements; [] clears all. A supplied list replaces all prior entries. Use catalog pad numbers, one entry per partId/padId.

direction.description: Conventional current relative to the net copper: into supplies it, out draws from it, bidirectional requires either direction.

requiredCurrentA.description: Required continuous current in amperes (mA/1000); zero is allowed.

organizationId.description: Organization ID from list_organizations. Omit for personal account boards; guest sessions cannot use organizations.

requestId.description: New UUID for this operation. Reuse it with identical arguments when retrying an uncertain result; use a new UUID for a different operation.

name: create_board

placementIssueCount.description: Total misplaced reference labels when more than the listed issues remain. Read the new revision after fixing a batch.

placementIssues.description: Authored reference labels that need attention on this saved revision. Use update_board with its boardRef, expectedRevision and a fresh requestId to apply a suggested side or exact position.

url.description: Private preview where the user can choose to save this board to My Boards. Keep the complete link in the originating conversation.

validation.description: Saved outcome of check_board_layout for the current layout. null: that layout has not been checked, or there is none; null is not a pass.
